title: Unimodularity of the tree basis matrix of the cycle space
statement: Let $T$ be a spanning tree of a finite digraph on vertex set $V$ with arc set $A$, and let $C$ be the integer basis matrix of the cycle space corresponding to $T$ — the matrix whose rows are indexed by the arcs outside $T$ and whose columns are indexed by all of $A$. Then $C$ is unimodular: every full square submatrix of $C$ formed by selecting a set of columns equal in number to the rows has determinant $0$, $+1$, or $-1$.
hypotheses_covered: T is a spanning tree of the digraph
C is the tree-T basis matrix of the cycle space (rows indexed by arcs outside T, columns by all arcs, integer entries)
